body.title: Evidence classes, the coverage prompt and finding normalization (daemon path)
body.summary: Add prepareCoverageGrounding (eligible symbols with coverageEvidence from testsReaching and the test record, including the null/malformed-record rule) and normalizeCoverageFindings(result, prepared, subject) to src/workflow/code-review/dimensions/coverage.ts; add findingKind (required) and symbolId to COVERAGE_FINDINGS_SCHEMA and DimensionFinding; the prompt lists eligible symbols with entityId and class, and on 'degraded' states symbol coverage cannot be graded; judgeCoverage uses both helpers and its JudgeContext.
acceptanceChecks: Evidence classes follow testsReaching and the record; with no record, a malformed record or no passing file an edge-free symbol is 'no-edge-no-tests'.

A HIGH is kept only for a promised test the plan lists or a symbol of class 'no-edge-no-tests'; every other HIGH (no findingKind, unknown or ambiguous symbolId, degraded symbol finding, unknown promised test) is lowered to LOW with the reason recorded.
A review whose only HIGHs were lowered does not fold to 'block'.
A diff review's prompt lists no symbols and says symbol coverage cannot be graded.
